tables.name: Users
checks: Email = LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Email))) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 AND Email LIKE N'%_@_%._%' AND Email NOT LIKE N'% %'
(ReportedAge IS NULL AND AgeRecordedAtUtc IS NULL) OR (ReportedAge IS NOT NULL AND ReportedAge BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND AgeRecordedAtUtc IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: Topics
checks: ParentTopicId IS NULL OR ParentTopicId <> TopicId

tables.name: Assessments
checks: (Kind='Placement' AND ScopeCourseId IS NOT NULL AND ScopeLevelId IS NULL AND ScopeLessonId IS NULL AND PassPercent IS NULL) OR (Kind='LevelQuiz' AND ScopeCourseId IS NULL AND ScopeLevelId IS NOT NULL AND ScopeLessonId IS NULL AND PassPercent IS NOT NULL AND PassPercent BETWEEN 0 AND 100) OR (Kind='LessonCheck' AND ScopeCourseId IS NULL AND ScopeLevelId IS NULL AND ScopeLessonId IS NOT NULL AND PassPercent IS NOT NULL AND PassPercent=100)

tables.name: AssessmentAttempts
checks: (Status='Submitted' AND (EvidenceOrigin='browser-import' OR SubmittedAtUtc IS NOT NULL) AND (SubmittedAtUtc IS NULL OR StartedAtUtc IS NULL OR SubmittedAtUtc >= StartedAtUtc)) OR (Status <> 'Submitted' AND SubmittedAtUtc IS NULL)
EvidenceOrigin='browser-import' OR StartedAtUtc IS NOT NULL
(EvidenceOrigin='browser-import' AND ImportedAtUtc IS NOT NULL) OR (EvidenceOrigin<>'browser-import' AND ImportedAtUtc IS NULL)

tables.name: AttemptAnswers
checks: (ResponseKind='option' AND OptionId IS NOT NULL) OR (ResponseKind='unsure' AND OptionId IS NULL)

tables.name: LessonCompletions
checks: (EvidenceOrigin='browser-import' AND CompletionMethod='imported' AND ImportedAtUtc IS NOT NULL) OR (EvidenceOrigin<>'browser-import' AND CompletionMethod<>'imported' AND ImportedAtUtc IS NULL AND CompletedAtUtc IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: CodeSubmissions
checks: EvidenceOrigin='browser-import' OR SubmittedAtUtc IS NOT NULL

(EvaluationStatus IN ('Pending','Running') AND FinishedAtUtc IS NULL) OR (EvaluationStatus IN ('Completed','Error','Cancelled') AND (EvidenceOrigin='browser-import' OR FinishedAtUtc IS NOT NULL) AND (FinishedAtUtc IS NULL OR SubmittedAtUtc IS NULL OR FinishedAtUtc >= SubmittedAtUtc))
(EvaluationStatus='Error' AND EvaluationError IS NOT NULL) OR (EvaluationStatus<>'Error' AND EvaluationError IS NULL)
(EvidenceOrigin='browser-import' AND ImportedAtUtc IS NOT NULL) OR (EvidenceOrigin<>'browser-import' AND ImportedAtUtc IS NULL)

tables.name: SubmissionTestResults
checks: (ExecutionStatus='Success' AND ErrorText IS NULL) OR (ExecutionStatus IN ('RuntimeError','Timeout') AND Passed=0 AND ErrorText IS NOT NULL)
